units.source_text: 源氏身为太政大臣，政务清闲，不须操心国事，

en.t: Since Genji was now Grand Minister, official affairs were light, and he did not need to trouble himself over matters of state,

units.source_text: 只管说说琐屑无聊的笑话，或者兴味津津地探察各侍女的心事。

en.t: so he simply passed the time telling trivial, idle jokes, or eagerly probing the thoughts of the various ladies in attendance.

units.source_text: 这个半老的右近，他也常常和她开玩笑。

en.t: With Ukon, who was now somewhat past her prime, he often joked in this way as well.

units.source_text: 此时便问她：“刚才你说在长谷寺遇见了一个人，是何等样人？

en.t: At this point he asked her, "You said just now that you met someone at Hasedera. What sort of person was it?

units.source_text: 是否结识了一个高贵的大和尚，带他来了么？”

en.t: Did you make the acquaintance of some eminent high priest and bring him back with you?"

units.source_text: 右近答道：“不要说这些难听的话！

en.t: Ukon answered, "Please do not say such unpleasant things!

units.source_text: 我是找到了我们那个短命而死的夕颜夫人的遗孤！”

en.t: What I found was the orphaned child of our Lady Yugao, who died so young!"

units.source_text: 大臣说：“唉，这个人真可怜！

en.t: The Minister said, "Ah, how pitiful that person is!
Where has she been living all these years?"

units.source_text: 右近觉得未便如实报告，答道：“住在荒僻的乡下地方。

en.t: Ukon felt it would not be proper to report the truth plainly, so she answered, "She has been living in a remote country place.

units.source_text: 还有几个从前的人照旧在服侍她。

en.t: A few people from the old days are still serving her as before.

units.source_text: 我对她说起了当年之事，她悲伤不堪呢。”

en.t: When I spoke to her about what happened back then, she was overcome with grief."

units.source_text: 大臣拦阻道：“好了，夫人不知道此事，你不要多说了。”

en.t: The Minister stopped her, saying, "Enough. My lady knows nothing of this, so do not say any more."

units.source_text: 紫姬说：“啊呀，这下可麻烦了！

en.t: Lady Murasaki said, "Oh dear, now this has become troublesome!

units.source_text: 我想睡了，听不清楚你们说些什么话。”

en.t: I want to sleep, and I cannot quite hear what you are saying."

units.source_text: 便举起衣袖来塞住了两耳。

en.t: Then she raised her sleeve and covered both her ears.
